FAQs

We’re here Monday to Saturday, 8:30am to 6:30pm. Email us any time.
sales@evtron.co.uk
Will it work with my car?
All three chargers use Type 2, which most battery-electric and plug-in hybrid cars sold in the UK use. If you’re unsure, check the charging port on your car or its handbook.
Tethered or untethered: what’s the difference?
A tethered charger has the cable permanently attached, so you just plug in. An untethered charger has a socket, and you use your own Type 2 cable.
Can I charge from my solar panels?
The two Fox chargers can use surplus solar power to charge your car. What you need depends on your inverter, and we’ll confirm it before you order.
Am I eligible for a government grant?

The OZEV chargepoint grant (75% of the cost, up to £500) is for people who rent, or own and live in a flat, with private off-street parking. People who own a house aren’t eligible. The scheme runs until 31 March 2027 (source: gov.uk).
Can I pay in instalments?
Yes. You can pay in full, or spread the cost with Klarna or PayPal Pay in 3, subject to status.
